note: Reports of SPG93 (NFU1-related spastic paraplegia) document mixed motor-sensory neuropathy emerging later in the disease course, such as in the third decade of life.

evidence.text: A patient with NFU1-associated spastic paraplegia developed a mixed sensory-motor demyelinating neuropathy in the third decade of life following earlier childhood spastic paraparesis and white matter changes.

source.title: New spastic paraplegia phenotype associated to mutation of NFU1
source.quote: The early white matter abnormalities observed on MRI was combined with a mixed sensory-motor neuropathy in the third decade.
